connector.name: Eyepup
connector.registryDescription: Agentic visitor analytics - five tools that hand the next CRO fix to your coding agent.
connector.summary: Hosted at eyepup.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package eyepup-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the edholofy account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
